verdicts.reason: Both use the same faithful three-column banner. In both, the stained-glass window has shrunk into a small icon that no longer anchors the design, and the address is at small-print size. A's headline is bigger, but it crowds the top and left edges, and the date/address block almost touches the right edge, so the side margins are tight and uneven. B has more even margins on all sides and a calmer balance, but its headline is a little smaller and the gutters between the three columns are not consistent.
